question: In a certain code language, 'SLEEK' is written as 'QICBI' and 'FROGS' is written as 'DOMDQ’. How will ‘HOPES be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'SLEEK' is written as 'QICBI',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b025b239741952b8f91e4be5987cd83512e01da33221517f5e6278a3305d1939.png] 

For, 'FROGS' is written as 'DOMDQ’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/996ef580533a2c19b29bc0a795189d5974d51cd230671294d52fda7328e10c25.png] 

Similarly, for 'HOPES':

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/43887924a56678e0c143205fd1d38866b3225b390beaca65881d606a6aba79e1.png] 

So, 'HOPES' will be written as 'FLNBQ'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
